left_defects.source: memoria cartarum ... revocatus a latentibus custodiis ... interceptus
left_defects.translation: recalled by his hidden keepers due to the importance of the papers
later apprehended in the same manner

why: Left garbles the recall-and-arrest sentence after the break and leaves a Latin word; right is faithful apart from the shared year error.
Both render the break identically; right mistranslates illius as your.

left_defects.source: huiffem. q maiori studio negotia tua geri n potuiffe ... nisi ut q pmum ptéis ad nos nauiges ... Vale.
left_defects.translation: (entire reply letter after the break missing; jumps to next letter)

why: Left drops the whole page-two continuation of the letter; right renders it.

left_defects.source: Dei, in quo ut caeteros errores taceam, de Trinitate ait ... an ergo non sunt de Ecclesia?
left_defects.translation: (Trinity and Church quotations missing after the break)

why: Left omits the entire paragraph that continues the crossing title; right renders it.

left_defects.source: nos dna et conforta nos in gra tua: vt pte ante aspectu dni pntem
left_defects.translation: (continuation of Benedicta... after the break missing)

right_defects.source: De profundis clamaui ad te domina: domina exaudi vocem meam
Domina non est exaltatum cor tuum: neque sublimati sunt oculi tui

why: At the break itself left drops the crossing continuation while right renders it, though right drops two verses earlier on the page.

left_defects.source: qui pretioso sanguine filii tui redempti sumus
left_defects.translation: whom you have redeemed with the precious blood

right_defects.translation: advocate of the poor, the pitier of the miserable

why: Left mistranslates port as power and makes Mary the redeemer; right has only a minor rearrangement.

right_defects.source: vnicuique qd suum erat iuste non / dedi
right_defects.translation: I did not justly give to each one what was his. / I gave.

right_defects.source: sapia, intellectus, consilium, scientia, fortitudo, pietas, timor dei
right_defects.translation: sapientia, intellectus, consilium, scientia, fortitudo, pietas, timor dei

why: Right renders the crossing verb twice and leaves the gifts in Latin; left carries the split sentence across.
Left inserts a meta note and a bracketed bridge not in the source; both slightly misrender a nobis.

left_defects.translation: when he could achieve nothing / able to obtain

why: Left duplicates the crossing clause and adds a bracketed bridge; right joins it cleanly.

right_defects.translation: crucified in the flesh, made manifest

why: Both share the same misreading at the break; right reads as a continuous sentence.
Left gets the following year right and translates everything; right errs on the year and leaves Latin.

left_defects.translation: Do not be angry enough to destroy us

why: Left adds a phrase and misreads inquam; right only leaves the Spirit name in Latin.

left_defects.translation: Condemning / this instruction is demanded of the Bishops

right_defects.translation: This instruction is condemned / from the Bishops, this instruction

why: Left changes the meaning of the crossing word; right keeps it but duplicates the subject.

left_defects.source: mundu sunt se gaudent restaurata. Per gloriosum tue virginitatis ... partus homines angelorum fiunt socii et conciues. Gloria

right_defects.source: mundu sunt se gaudent restaurata. Per gloriosum tue virginitatis ... conciues. Gloria

right_defects.translation: penetrate both the heights and the depths
the bridegroom, your most beloved son

why: Both drop the crossing sentence; right adds two mistranslations nearby.

left_defects.source: durch andere Leute darzu angetrieben, damit fortzufahren
left_defects.translation: be driven forward by other people

why: Both carry Augsburg Confession across the break correctly; left has a minor earlier slip that does not touch the junction.
Right misreads beatificatis and satietas after the break; left renders both correctly.
